day_summary: GATE 3 DAY 10 — THE $225 BREAKOUT CONFIRMED: NVDA $225.30 (+$1.21 / +0.54%), closing above $225 for the first time in Gate 3 after nine consecutive sessions of resistance at that level. The session tested $223.71 in early trading — briefly probing below $224 as sellers attempted a fade — before institutional buyers stepped in, pushed through the Gate 3 primary resistance to an intraday high of $227.23, and held the close at $225.30 (a $1.93 fade from the session high). The $225 resistance that repelled closes on Days 1-9 (two intraday wicks: Day 7 $225.00, Day 9 $225.10) has been absorbed: the close at $225.30 is the first time NVDA has ended a Gate 3 session above $225. Day range $223.71-$227.23 confirms a 1.56% trading corridor with sellers defending $227.23 but unable to prevent a close above the critical gate. Specific session volume was not available at publication time; the prior framework condition required >130M shares for the highest-quality confirmation of the breakout, while the close itself is the primary conviction trigger. Market backdrop: Post-CPI clean tape with no major macro catalysts; Nasdaq continued its AI-led advance; Korean semiconductor index in bull market territory (KOSPI +22% from July 30 low, SK Hynix +5.92%, Temasek SWF targeting Korean memory chips). Gate 3 conditions: (1) NVDA $225.30 > $200 (buffer +$25.30 — new Gate 3 record); (2) SPX estimated ~7,780 > 7,460 (buffer +$320); (3) VIX estimated ~13.8 < 17 (buffer ~3.2 — strongest of the cycle). 13 days to Aug 26 Q2 FY2027 earnings ($91B guidance). Framework conviction upgrades to HIGH.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Gate 3 Day 10 — The Breakout Confirmed

August 13, 2026 is the session Gate 3 was built toward. After nine consecutive sessions in which $225 served as an inviolable resistance ceiling — repelling two intraday wicks (Day 7: $225.00, Day 9: $225.10) without a single closing breach — Day 10 delivered the first confirmed close above $225 at $225.30. The framework's primary conviction trigger has been pulled.

### Gate 3 Conditions — Day 10

| Condition | Threshold | Day 9 (Aug 12) | Day 10 (Aug 13) | Status |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------------|--------|
| (1) NVDA price | > $200 | $224.09 (+$24.09) | $225.30 (+$25.30) | ✓ CLEARED — new record |
| (2) SPX | > 7,460 | ~7,751 (+$291) | ~7,780 (+$320) | ✓ CLEARED |
| (3) VIX | < 17 | ~14.2 (~2.8 buffer) | ~13.8 (~3.2 buffer) | ✓ CLEARED — strongest reading |

All three conditions are cleared at their best combined reading since Gate 3 began July 31.

### The Session Structure

Day 10 was a quiet, grinding post-CPI continuation with no major new catalysts. The action told the story:
- **Early weakness**: $223.71 session low — sellers attempted to fade the Day 9 close of $224.09, pressing into the $223-$224 range; buyers absorbed the selling quickly
- **Rally through resistance**: Buyers accumulated through $225 and pushed to $227.23 — the first time NVDA traded above $225.10 (Day 9's intraday peak) in Gate 3
- **Fade from high**: $227.23 → $225.30 close — a $1.93 reversal from the session high; sellers above $227 are present and active; but they could only push the close back to $225.30, not below $225
- **The critical result**: Close at $225.30 — the FIRST Gate 3 close above $225

The day's 1.56% trading range ($223.71-$227.23) on a modest +0.54% gain is consistent with a grinding absorption day rather than an explosive institutional breakout. This is the quality caveat: a definitive institutional accumulation signal would typically manifest as a larger day-over-day gain and above-average volume on the breakout candle.

### The Ten-Session Resistance Absorption Sequence

| Session | High | Close | Fade from High | First time close above $225? |
|---------|------|-------|----------------|------------------------------|
| Day 7 (Aug 10) | $225.00 | $217.54 | $7.46 | No |
| Day 8 (Aug 11) | $222.40 | $217.40 | $5.00 | No |
| Day 9 (Aug 12) | $225.10 | $224.09 | $1.01 | No |
| Day 10 (Aug 13) | $227.23 | $225.30 | $1.93 | **YES — FIRST TIME** |

The progression of fades ($7.46, $5.00, $1.01) told the story of exhaustion. Day 10's $1.93 fade from a higher high ($227.23 vs Day 9's $225.10) while still closing above $225 is the confirmation that sellers have run out of ammunition at the critical level. The $1.93 fade is slightly larger than Day 9's $1.01, but the close is $1.21 higher. What matters: for the first time in Gate 3, the close is above $225.

### Volume — The Open Question

Specific volume data for Day 10 was not confirmed at publication time. The prior framework guidance specified >130M shares for the highest-quality breakout signal (vs. the ~93-128M average). Three scenarios:

1. **Volume > 130M (best case)**: Institutional accumulation confirmed; HIGH conviction fully warranted; $230 momentum likely accelerates in Day 11-12.
2. **Volume ~70-93M (likely given the quiet +0.54% session)**: Breakout is technically valid (close confirms) but the institutional conviction is questioned; monitor Day 11 volume closely; HIGH conviction maintained per the close criterion but requires follow-through confirmation.
3. **Volume < 57M (worst case)**: Mechanical-only close above $225 (short covers + delta hedges, no new institutional longs); a Day 11 close below $225 is a meaningful false-breakout signal; conviction reverts to MEDIUM.

The session profile — a quiet +0.54% move on no major catalysts — is consistent with scenario 2. Day 11 (Aug 14) volume will be the first real data point on whether institutional buyers are following the close with new long commitments.

### ★ Strongest Support — $225.00 (Resistance Flipped)

Evidence for $225 as support after Day 10:
1. **Nine sessions of absorption**: Every supply overhang at $225 has been exhausted through Days 1-10; the sellers who repeatedly drove $5-7 reversal candles can now only manage $1-2 fades from higher highs
2. **Options dynamic inversion**: $225 call sellers who maintained mechanical selling near $225 (delta-hedging short calls) now face the opposite dynamic — with $225 calls in-the-money at close, they must BUY shares to maintain delta-neutral; the prior resistance dynamic has INVERTED to support
3. **Stop-loss anchor**: Framework longs who entered on the Day 10 close will defend $225 as their stop — this creates a structural bid at $225 for future sessions
4. **Psychological significance**: After 9 sessions of resistance, $225 becomes the most important reference price in the Gate 3 framework; institutional algorithms and human traders alike will watch the $225 level intently

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $227.23 (Today's High; Supply Zone)

Evidence:
1. Sellers defended $227.23 with a clean $1.93 reversal — the largest intraday reversal from the session high among the three days that tested above $225 (Day 7: $225.00-$217.54 = wick; Day 9: $225.10-$224.09 = $1.01; Day 10: $227.23-$225.30 = $1.93)
2. The $225-$230 call OI zone is the earnings-run positioning area; $227-$228 likely has elevated call open interest from accounts building $225-$230 call spreads; these sellers will delta-hedge by selling near $227-$228
3. No prior technical reference at $227.23 — this is the session high only; it can be cleared quickly with volume

### VOLUME is the Key Watch Variable for Day 11

The breakout quality is decided in Day 11 (Aug 14). If Day 11:
- Opens above $225 and closes above $225 on above-average volume (>130M shares) → Institutional confirmation; $230 is the immediate target; HIGH conviction fully justified
- Opens above $225 and closes above $225 on below-average volume → Grind continues; $225 is holding but not yet institutional-grade; watch for volume build in Days 12-13
- Closes below $225 → False breakout; conviction reverts to MEDIUM; the 10-session failed breakout is a bearish signal; reassess

### Pre-Earnings Setup — 13 Days to Aug 26

The standard NVDA pre-earnings momentum pattern (using AI earnings season as confirmation — CRWV +18%, SMCI +9%, Nebius +16.5%, SK Hynix +5.54%/+5.92%):
- $225 → $230: 2.1% gain, approximately 2-3 sessions at Day 10 momentum pace
- $230 → $235.47-$236.54: additional 2.4%, approximately 3-5 more sessions
- Total pre-earnings run potential: 4.5% over 5-10 sessions before Aug 26

With 13 days of runway and the macro framework at its best-of-cycle reading, this is the cleanest pre-earnings setup NVDA has had since Gate 3 began.

### What Confirms vs. What Invalidates

**Breakout confirmation (HIGH conviction sustained):**
1. Day 11 close above $225 — validates that Day 10 was not an isolated close; the primary hold criterion
2. Day 11-12 volume > 130M shares on up days → institutional accumulation confirmed
3. Close above $230 → earnings momentum run is live; $235.47-$236.54 becomes the immediate target

**False breakout signals (reverts to MEDIUM):**
1. Day 11 closes below $225 — the critical bearish signal; 10-session failed breakout is a strongly bearish reversal pattern
2. Below-average volume over multiple days following the breakout → the close was mechanical (short covers/delta hedges), not institutional accumulation
3. No follow-through: Days 11-13 range-bound between $222-$225 without any close above $225 → sellers have re-established control of the level
